t: Titan TTB1357STM 2000W wallpaper stripper provides quick, effective wallpaper removal without the need for chemicals. Suitable for decorators and DIYers tackling large-scale home renovation projects. A large, easy-fill 4Ltr water tank provides up to 80 minutes of continuous steam, reducing downtime on site, whilst the 2-in-1 steam plate reaches into tight corners as well as covering wide wall areas efficiently. The long 3m hose and 2m cable offer excellent reach around rooms. Safety cut-out feature prevents overheating during prolonged use. Supplied large and small steam plates, hose and power cord. Equipped with a carry handle.
b: Steam Power Removes Wallpaper Safely & Cleanly
2-in-1 Steam Plate For Large Wall Areas & Tight Corners
Integrated Carry Handle Allows Easy Transport & Storage
